"sec12-R07", "sec12-R08"], "heading": "C2 — KG handoff hints: crashes and insurance", "learner_facing": false, "markdown": "## C2 — KG handoff: Section 12 crashes and insurance

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
An involved driver must halt at once at the scene and stay until duties are done, with leaving carrying severe penalties [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crash-duties; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec12-R02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
A driver in a property-damage-only crash may clear travel lanes to a safe nearby spot, but must remain until exchange duties finish [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crash-duties; prereq_hint sec12-R01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-R01.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
Notice to law enforcement is required at once when a crash brings injury, death, or the stated total property-damage threshold [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crash-reporting; prereq_hint sec12-R01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-R02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A02
A disabled vehicle must be made visible with flashers, hood signal, marker cloth, warning devices placed well behind, plus a call for help [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint emergency-response; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec12-R08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A03
Operating without required owner security is a misdemeanor class that can cost license, registration, and plates until proof and payments return [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint financial-responsibility; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-R06.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A03
An unsatisfied damage judgment suspends driving privilege after the stated grace period until paid plus future-proof filing [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint financial-responsibility; prereq_hint sec12-R05; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-R05.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A04
Required liability and no-fault injury benefits differ from uninsured-motorist injury cover, collision cover, and comprehensive non-collision cover [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint insurance-coverage; prereq_hint sec12-R05; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-R06.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A02
With anti-lock brakes keep the pedal pressed hard through vibration and keep steering, while a non-equipped car follows its manual method [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint emergency-response; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-R04.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0077]
